description: This file defines the ImageToolkitOperationManager class, which manages image toolkit operation plugins within Drupal. It includes methods for constructing plugin instances, retrieving plugin IDs based on toolkit and operation, and handling plugin definitions. It also manages dependencies such as cache, module handler, and toolkit manager.

classes.name: ImageToolkitOperationManager
classes.description: Manages image toolkit operation plugins, providing methods to create plugin instances and retrieve plugin IDs based on toolkit and operation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the ImageToolkitOperationManager with dependencies such as namespaces, cache backend, module handler, logger, and toolkit manager.

methods.name: getToolkitOperationPluginId
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin ID for a specific toolkit and operation, handling fallback to base toolkit if necessary.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a plugin instance by plugin ID, configuration, and optional toolkit, setting the toolkit on the instance.

methods.name: getToolkitOperation
methods.description: Gets a plugin instance for a specific toolkit and operation.
